envelope.description: Define strict probe contracts and private grants

body.title: Define strict probe contracts and private grants
body.summary: Add proposed src/shared/review-investigation-probe.ts schemas and optional LLMProvider probe capability in src/shared/types.ts; add a proposed provider-local opaque single-use probe grant registry. Define start/status/cancel/export, UUID identity, observation verdicts, nullable accounting and unsigned candidate shape. Preserve NativeIsolationEvidence version 1 and production binding APIs.
acceptanceChecks: Reject arbitrary launch args/prompts/paths/keys or caller-claimed effective inventory.
Serialized/forged/scripted grants cannot invoke installed probes or production reviewSession.
Version/mode/state/observation schemas retain explicit unsupported and unknown values.

tests.name: Probe schemas reject launch overrides, forged/serialized grants and invalid observation states
Probe capability remains optional and cannot supply production qualification
